https://jhmcri.com/about-jakir-hossain-m.text: Jakir Hossain Medical College – Best & Recognized Medical College Welcome to Jakir Hossain Medical College and Research Institute Jakir Hossain Medical College & Research Institute (JHMC&RI) is a medical institution located in Murshidabad, West Bengal. Established by the Shibham Education and Social Welfare Trust in 2023, the college aims to provide quality medical education and train future doctors to serve the healthcare needs of the community and the nation. JHMC&RI offers the MBBS programme with a strong focus on academic fundamentals, clinical skill development and ethical patient care. The college provides a supportive environment with modern infrastructure to help students grow into competent and responsible medical professionals. Vision & Mission Statement Vision To create a centre of academic excellence in medical education that contributes to the health and well-being of society through quality teaching, clinical training and community service. Mission To offer advanced medical care to the underprivileged of the society along with offering scope for medical research benefitting the human kind at large. Why Choose Jakir Hossain Medical College for MBBS Admissions Jakir Hossain Medical College and Research Institute is an emerging centre of excellence in medical education, dedicated to shaping competent and compassionate doctors prepared to meet the evolving healthcare needs of society. Established by the Shibham Education and Social Welfare Trust, the college is committed to delivering high-quality medical training and fostering a culture of academic integrity and professional excellence. The college offers a comprehensive MBBS programme structured in accordance with National Medical Commission guidelines, combining rigorous academic learning with practical clinical exposure to prepare students for real-world medical practice. Students benefit from a multi-specialty teaching hospital attached to the campus, where they gain hands-on experience in patient care, clinical rounds, and practical sessions under the guidance of experienced medical professionals. Leadership & Governance JHMC&RI is guided by its leadership team, which oversees academic, administrative and hospital operations Mr Jakir Hossain Chairman Dr. Dipak Kumar Das President Dr. Nirjhar Bhattacharya Dean & Principal Prof (Dr.) Naresh Shyamsunder Gurbani Medical Superintendent, JHMCRI Infrastructure & Facilities Why Students Trust Jakir Hossain Medical College * Academic block equipped with lecture halls and teaching spaces * Well-established laboratories and departmental facilities * Central library measuring approximately with over 7,000 book volumes * Dedicated reading room facilities * Hostel facilities for students * Residential quarters * Indoor and outdoor sporting & recreational facilities * Jakir Hossain Medical College follows the regulations and guidelines laid down by the National Medical Commission (NMC) ( https://www.nmc.org.in ), ensuring quality medical education standards in India. * The institution aligns with healthcare standards promoted by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India ( https://www.mohfw.gov.in ), supporting excellence in medical learning and patient care. Know More Jakir Hossain Medical College Jakir Hossain Medical College & Research Institute is a medical education institution dedicated to providing structured medical learning, clinical exposure and healthcare training in a professional academic environment. Which university is the college affiliated with? The college is affiliated with The West Bengal University of Health Sciences (WBUHS), ensuring that its curriculum and academic processes follow established university guidelines. Also Jakir Hossain Medical College follows the regulations and guidelines laid down by the National Medical Commission (NMC) ( https://www.nmc.org.in ), ensuring quality medical education standards in India. The institution aligns with healthcare standards promoted by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India ( https://www.mohfw.gov.in ), supporting excellence in medical learning and patient care. Does the college provide clinical and hospital exposure to students? Yes, students receive practical learning and hospital-based clinical exposure through the associated healthcare facilities to support real-world medical training. What kind of infrastructure does the college offer? The institution offers classroom learning environments, laboratories, library facilities, hospital training setup and supporting infrastructure to facilitate academic and clinical education.

https://jhmcri.com/principal-message-jhm.text: Principal's Message JHMCRI (Jakir Hossain Medical College & Research Institute) Prof. (Dr.) Nirjhar Bhattacharya, Dean & Principal Dear Students and Aspirants, Welcome to Jakir Hossain Medical College & Research Institute (JHMCRI) , Murshidabad, West Bengal—where medical education meets purpose , knowledge transforms into skill, and clinical training grows into compassion and responsibility. As the Dean & Principal , it is my responsibility to ensure that every MBBS student at Jakir Hossain Medical College receives a strong academic foundation along with meaningful real-world clinical exposure. At JHMCRI , our MBBS curriculum is designed to balance academic rigor with hands-on learning, guided by highly qualified and experienced faculty members. Supported by modern infrastructure , advanced teaching methodologies and structured training, we strive to prepare future doctors who are confident, knowledgeable and ethically grounded. Our college offers: Well-equipped modern laboratories A comprehensive central library and departmental libraries A dedicated teaching hospital for continuous clinical exposure Supportive academic and residential facilities These resources ensure that students at Jakir Hossain Medical College are guided at every stage of their medical journey. We understand that becoming a doctor is not only about clearing examinations—it is about building character, discipline, empathy, clinical judgment, leadership and a deep commitment to serve society . As highlighted in this Principal Message of Jakir Hossain Medical College , our institution is dedicated to nurturing doctors who uphold ethics and deliver healthcare with responsibility and compassion. I encourage every student to embrace sincerity, hard work and dedication during their MBBS journey at JHMCRI , Murshidabad. The education you receive here will shape your future and impact the health and wellbeing of countless lives. On behalf of the institution, I extend my best wishes to all aspiring doctors and students becoming part of Jakir Hossain Medical College , one of the trusted medical colleges in West Bengal near Kolkata. Wishing you success, growth and purpose in your journey ahead.
